top_signals.title: Unrivaled CEO Discusses New Funding, Expansion
top_signals.summary: Alex Bazzell, CEO and co-founder Unrivaled, joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." Unrivaled, the 3-on-3 women’s basketball league founded by WNBA stars Breanna Stewart and Napheesa Collier. The league, founded in 2023, now has a valuation of $650 million, nearly doubling from September 2025. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Power, Infrastructure At Center of Data-Center Deals
top_signals.summary: Maria Goodpaster, Partner at McKinsey & Company, Kate Dorsey, Managing Director at Stonepeak, and Melissa Kalka, M&A, Private Equity Partner at Kirkland & Ellis, join Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals" to discuss data-center dealmaking.  (Source: Bloomberg)
